title: Strong finite-time approximation of zero-potential H-type Schroedinger solutions by ground-state noncommutative wave packets
difficulty_reason: H3: propagation of a semiclassical measure specifies only weak concentration and does not construct an L2 or weighted-Sobolev approximation of the actual solution. The author builds a finite operator-valued corrector hierarchy in the moving central frame, inverts the harmonic-oscillator commutator on off-diagonal pieces, and cancels the successive singular and half-order remainders. Creation-annihilation identities identify the remaining diagonal correction with a scalar selfadjoint differential operator on the profile, leading to its effective evolution equation and a residual controlled by an energy estimate in the scaled weighted spaces. This independent strong approximate-solution/effective-profile construction is new beyond the initial packet and necessary-time counterexample. Only V=0 and the first Hermite h0/h0 theorem is selected; arbitrary harmonics and stronger all-time claims do not inherit the qualification.
